title: On-Crystal Spectral Modulator from Polarized Propagation of Lanthanide-Titanium Nanoclusters

synthesis.procedure: Ti(OiPr)4 (18.0 μL, 0.06 mmol) was added to a solution of 4-fluorobenzoic acid (0.070 g, 0.5 mmol) and Eu(OAc)3·3H2O (0.0164 g, 0.05 mmol) in acetonitrile (2.25 mL) and tetrahydrofuran (0.75 mL) in a glass vial. The solution was stirred for 30 min and heated at approximately 80 °C for 900 min. After cooling to room temperature, colorless plate-shaped crystals formed. The product was washed thoroughly with acetonitrile and dried at 30 °C under vacuum for 1 h.
synthesis.time: 30 min stirring, 900 min heating, 1 h drying
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cooling to room temperature gave colorless plate-shaped crystals, which were washed with acetonitrile and vacuum-dried at 30 °C for 1 h.

properties.summary: Eu8Ti10 shows antenna-sensitized Eu3+ emission, a photoluminescence quantum yield of about 81.1%, a room-temperature lifetime of about 1.4 ms, and strongly polarized crystal emission that supports anisotropic optical waveguiding and on-crystal spectral modulation.

measurements.name: photoluminescence lifetime
measurements.conditions: room temperature; single-exponential decay, emission monitored in the temperature-dependent study at 611 nm

measurements.name: Judd-Ofelt Ω2
measurements.conditions: derived from the electric-dipole to magnetic-dipole transition-rate ratio

measurements.name: waveguide loss coefficient
measurements.conditions: X direction (crystal b axis), 5D0→7F1 Peak-iii, σ-polarized light; 52.14% loss per mm

measurements.name: waveguide loss coefficient
measurements.conditions: X direction (crystal b axis), 5D0→7F1 Peak-i, π-polarized light; 76.56% loss per mm

measurements.name: EDT/MDT intensity ratio after waveguide propagation
measurements.conditions: ratio of 5D0→7F2 to 5D0→7F1 from the excited site to the out-coupled edges

synthesis.procedure: Nd8Ti10 was prepared by the Eu8Ti10 method, substituting Nd(OAc)3·4H2O for Eu(OAc)3·3H2O, with the other steps kept similar: Ti(OiPr)4 (18.0 μL, 0.06 mmol) and 4-fluorobenzoic acid (0.070 g, 0.5 mmol) in acetonitrile (2.25 mL) and tetrahydrofuran (0.75 mL), stirred 30 min and heated at approximately 80 °C for 900 min in a glass vial, followed by cooling, acetonitrile washing, and vacuum drying at 30 °C for 1 h. No separate Nd salt mass or yield is stated.
synthesis.time: 30 min stirring, 900 min heating, 1 h drying
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Same cooling, acetonitrile wash, and vacuum drying as the Eu procedure; crystals were structurally characterized.

properties.summary: Gd8Ti10 was used to locate the ligand triplet from its low-temperature phosphorescence; the ligand singlet and triplet support the antenna pathway discussed for Eu8Ti10. No magnetic data are reported.

measurements.name: ligand triplet energy from phosphorescence
measurements.conditions: shortest-wavelength phosphorescence band of the ligand in Gd8Ti10 at 77 K; 410 nm

measurements.name: ligand singlet energy
measurements.conditions: estimated from the UV/vis absorption edge of FBA at 328 nm; reported with the Gd8Ti10 energy-level diagram
